description: Pre-arrival guest asks to confirm sheets/blankets/pillows for a 4th guest sleeping on the couch. Must confirm linens are provided AND mention they are stored in/under the sofa itself (storage compartment) — not just a bare yes. Real production case (Amy).
guestMessage: Hi Jerome and Ruby, we're looking forward to our stay. I just want to make sure there are sheets/blankets/pillows for our friend (our 4th) who will be sleeping on the couch. Please confirm. Thank you! -Amy
notes: Production incident: reply was good but omitted that linens are in the sofa storage compartment. Matches auto-reply-grok-sqs SLEEPING_ARRANGEMENTS / SOFA_BED_SIZE behavior.
